item.description:
### Prayers
- A Prayers tab: today's times under the sky of the current prayer, a live countdown, and the times computed on your Mac from your location — nothing is tracked. - The countdown follows Muslims Day exactly: Duha and the prohibited windows around sunrise and noon count down as "Waqt ends in", in HH:MM:SS. - The timeline's gradient advances with the clock toward the next prayer. - Set your city by search — tapping a result applies it immediately — or use Detect my location. - A desktop prayer widget (small and medium) shows the countdown and today's times.
